# KR Brothers Crane Service

KR Brothers is the short brand name used by KR Brothers Crane Service.

> KR Brothers provides crane and Hydra rental, lifting, machinery shifting, loading and unloading, and breakdown recovery services from Khizarpur (Hajipur), Tehsil Mukerian, District Hoshiarpur, Punjab, India. Contact the business to confirm service availability for a specific site.

## Contact

- Business location: Vill. Khizarpur (Hajipur), Teh. Mukerian, Distt. Hoshiarpur, Punjab 144221, India
- Operating since: 2015
- Lifting capacity: 0–16 tons, subject to the selected machine's load chart and site conditions
- Hours: 24 hours, all 7 days. Confirm machine, crew and mobilisation availability for the specific job.
- Quote enquiries: Share the load weight and dimensions, working radius, lift height, site location, access conditions, number of lifts and expected duration. Rates and mobilisation depend on the job.
